description: Implementation of WebSocketDeflateStream class handling deflation/inflation of WebSocket frames with compression, including reading, writing, and frame processing logic.

classes.name: WebSocketDeflateStream
classes.description: Handles WebSocket frame compression and decompression with deflate algorithm, managing frame reading, writing, and frame processing states.

methods.name: ReadFrames
methods.description: Reads WebSocket frames from the stream, inflates if necessary, and invokes callback upon completion.

methods.name: WriteFrames
methods.description: Deflates frames if applicable and writes them to the stream.

methods.name: GetSubProtocol
methods.description: Returns the subprotocol string of the WebSocket stream.

methods.name: GetExtensions
methods.description: Returns the extensions string of the WebSocket stream.

methods.name: GetNetLogWithSource
methods.description: Returns the network log source associated with the stream.

methods.name: OnReadComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked when a read operation completes, handling inflation or error.

methods.name: Deflate
methods.description: Compresses frames using deflate algorithm, managing frame states and predictor logic.

methods.name: OnMessageStart
methods.description: Determines whether to deflate or not based on predictor prediction at the start of a message.

methods.name: AppendCompressedFrame
methods.description: Creates a compressed frame from deflater output and appends to frames to write.

methods.name: AppendPossiblyCompressedMessage
methods.description: Decides whether to compress a message or send uncompressed based on compression effectiveness.

methods.name: Inflate
methods.description: Decompresses frames using inflater, generating inflated frames.

methods.name: InflateAndReadIfNecessary
methods.description: Performs inflation and reads more frames if needed until complete or error.
